name: Ice and fire enso brush circle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original raster image for the center of a minimalist academic workshop website, displayed at about 220 pixels high.
Primary request: A Zen-like enso brush circle with one ice part and one fire part.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly pure white (#FFFFFF), no paper tint or background texture.
Subject: exactly one balanced, almost continuous open circle painted with thin-to-medium tactile dry-brush strokes. Upper and left arc in muted icy blue and slate pigment, lower and right arc in restrained warm rust and ember pigment. A modest natural gap with tapered stroke ends. This must read as a single enso circle, not two detached arcs. The circle has a very airy, empty white center.
Style/medium: sophisticated restrained hand-painted dry-brush ink. Natural bristle marks and subtle pigment imperfections. Quiet Zen-like academic elegance.
Composition/framing: square canvas. A simple centered circular silhouette occupying about 66 percent of the canvas width and height, with generous even white margins. Plenty of open white interior. Clearly legible at small size.
Color palette: subdued icy blue/slate and warm rust/ember on pure white.
Constraints: suggest ice and fire through pigment color only, with at most the tiniest restrained texture at the painted edge. Keep the brush width thin to medium, never a heavy ring. Exactly one mark and no other objects.
Avoid: literal flames, ice mountains, crystals, yin-yang motifs or dots, characters, numbers, text, signatures, logos, watermarks, background scene, glow, gradients, shadows, color washes, dramatic flourishes, extravagant effects, thick torus forms, splatter outside the circle.
Generate one image only.
visualInspection: Single dry-brush open circle, blue/slate upper and left arc, warm rust-orange lower and right arc, modest gap at upper right, white background and airy center. No text or literal fire/ice objects. Original generated bitmap preserved without edits.
